title: The coat from behind
venue: the coast community-college paper, Newport · the laundromat digest
source: lore/drift_wood/_THE_COMPLETE_RUN.md (1999–2000 · deepening xix · the daily filled)
logline: Friday. The cover is the coat from behind, walking away up 101 on the shoulder, the dog beside, the collar up. No face. The owner says it's him. Wood says it's a coat. She says she'd know that coat anywhere. He says that's the idea.

panels.composition: The cover: a man in a chore coat from behind on a highway shoulder in rain, collar up, hands in pockets, a small dog beside. No face.

image.prompt: close on a photocopied booklet cover showing a man in a canvas chore coat from behind walking a highway shoulder in rain with a small dog, black and white, no words
image.notes: Wood from behind: the pose the strip settles on (characters.md wood_44: 'usually drawn from behind'). Begins here.

panels.composition: The laundromat. The LAUNDRY owner. WOOD in the coat. BARNABY.

panels.composition: The rack. The coat from behind facing the room. The strip found the pose it will use for twenty-seven years and it's a back. Twenty strokes.
